NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 24, 11:26 AM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 23.7 DraftKings points for $8,400, at Las Vegas. Amon-Ra St. Brown (18.8, $7,800) and Zay Flowers (18.4, $6,900) are next.

Puka Nacua is also the top value at the position: 2.82 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 24, 11:26 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 7

Puka Nacua, LAR at LV ($8,400)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 23.7 DraftKings points at $8,400, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 4.8 points clear of Amon-Ra St. Brown. The model gives him 11.7 targets on 33.4 routes. The salary works out to 2.82 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 27 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 23.7 points with a simulated floor of 11.2 and a ceiling of 44.2, and he holds 18% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 3-point favorite on the road against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 25.75 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs GB ($7,800)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 2nd at the position with 18.8 DraftKings points at $7,800. The model gives him 9.9 targets on 34.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.42 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 27 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 18.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 37.9, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 28.25 in a game totaled at 53.5.

Zay Flowers, BAL vs CIN ($6,900)

Zay Flowers projects 3rd at the position with 18.4 DraftKings points at $6,900. The model gives him 8.5 targets on 26.5 routes. The salary works out to 2.66 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 27 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Flowers averaged 18.5 points with a simulated floor of 6.9 and a ceiling of 37.8, and he holds 18% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Baltimore is a 1.5-point underdog at home against Cincinnati, with an implied team total of 23 in a game totaled at 47.5.

Value: Matthew Golden, GB at DET ($6,000)

Matthew Golden projects for 16.5 DraftKings points at $6,000, which works out to 2.75 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 27 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 7.9 targets on 32.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Golden averaged 16.5 points with a simulated floor of 5.2 and a ceiling of 35.6, and he holds 23% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Green Bay is a 3-point underdog on the road against Detroit, with an implied team total of 25.25 in a game totaled at 53.5.
